verdict.rationale: Proa documents built-in signals, but only inside individual hydrated islands, each with its own seed state. WebContext provides request-scoped data and route state on the server. Nothing in the pack shows a built-in primitive for global application state shared across islands or the app, so these local and request-scoped features are adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage global application state using built-in primitives without adding a third-party library
